purpose: Independent offline research on cost variance and early cost risk; no model API calls and no personal logs.
split: Task instance SHA256 first 8 hex digits modulo 10: 0,1 final test; 2,3 validation; 4..9 train. All configurations and repeated runs of a task stay together.
prediction_population: Common scaffold trajectories that reach the tenth tool result, have positive reported cost, and evaluation_matches_selected=true. Native systems separately descriptive only.
prefix_boundary: Immediately after tenth tool result, inclusive; full-run usage, steps, wall time, exit status, outcome, final messages are forbidden as features.
target: Final total reported USD cost; remaining USD unavailable without per-event usage. Source cost is historical harness accounting, not audited invoices.
models: M0 training arithmetic mean cost per configuration; M1 random forest regressors on log1p(cost), fixed 300 trees, min_samples_leaf=15, max_depth=8, seed=1706. Back-transform via training-only Duan residual smearing. Evaluate M1 configuration+language and M2 those+prefix features. No hyperparameter search on final test.
uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap samples over heldout task IDs, preserving all configurations and runs per sampled task; percentile 95% CI of relative WAPE improvement.
risk_alert: High cost defined by training-only 90th percentile within each configuration; select alert threshold on validation to approximately 10% alerts; report final-test precision, recall, actual alert rate and cost share. No automatic stopping or savings claims.
right_fit_terms: Descriptive cost/quality comparisons only. Do not use to train, fine-tune or distill models. No benchmark text is redistributed.
interpretation: Configurations are not human users; this does not validate multi-user weekly cost prediction, prove production savings, or estimate causal effects of interrupting a run. Benchmark success is not human acceptance.
